title: Aww (Crowd)
blurb: A studio audience melting in unison, which is a strange thing to have on tap. The crowd aww is the laugh track's soft-hearted sibling, built for the exact moment a sitcom child says something unexpectedly sweet, and it carries all of that manufactured warmth with it. Play it over puppies, babies, and grown men being unexpectedly gentle — or deploy it ironically at something that is emphatically not cute, which is where most of the comedy lives. Either way the audience has spoken, and the audience finds it precious.
